Business Travel Wellness Integrator 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launches a descriptive skill for integrating wellness into business travel planning.
- Provides frameworks, templates, and heuristic analysis for wellness-focused trip preparation.
- Supports modules for wellness assessment, routine adaptation, recovery optimization, and performance sustainability.
- Returns structured, actionable recommendations based on travel context inputs.
- Does not execute code, rely on external APIs, or perform real bookings; offers informational guidance only.
